title: MomentPick
description: LLM output of pick_moment: the moment the poem centres on, and the beats it follows.

title.description: One line naming the moment, such as: The comeback, from the red card to the winner.

event_refs.description: source_refs of the events that make up the moment itself.

beats.description: 2 to 5 event source_refs in match order, including the moment.
